narrative.intro: Harris reached $95.1M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Harris won 7 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $13.6M. Harris obligations are down 91.9% year over year. Harris has moved through a multi-year rise in obligations, climbing from $313M in FY22 to $1.2B in FY26 before the current FY27 partial total. Harris current-year totals are partial because the period covers fiscal year to date, and the report distinguishes contract obligations from total award values in specific tables. Harris figures here are obligations unless a table specifically notes award-value. Harris activity this fiscal year is a much smaller slice compared with the most recent full fiscal year, given the reported year-over-year change. Harris historical totals show steady growth through FY26, followed by the FY27 partial total of $95.1M that reflects ongoing work or newly recorded obligations for the fiscal year to date.

sections.body: Harris obligations fell 91.9% year over year. Harris has $95.1M in obligations in FY2027 to date compared with $1.2B in FY26. Harris current-year totals are partial, so the FY27 figure represents fiscal year to date obligations rather than a full-year total.

sections.heading: How have Harris obligations changed across recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Obligations rose from $313M in FY22 to $1.2B in FY26 before the FY27 partial total of $95.1M. The sequence by fiscal year is $313M in FY22, $386M in FY23, $459M in FY24, $918M in FY25, $1.2B in FY26, and $95.1M in FY27. Harris shows a multi-year increase through FY26 followed by the FY27 fiscal year to date amount.
